home.pitch: One detail, from very close. The picture slowly pulls back. Can you name it before the end?
home.failed: The game could not start. Check your connection and try again.

scoringHint.decay: The faster you find it, the more it pays: from 1000 down to 200 points.
scoringHint.fixed: The first to find it gets 1000 points, the second 800, the third 600, everyone after 500. Time does not count.

displayHint.phones: Everyone sees the picture on their own phone.
displayHint.bigscreen: The picture goes on a TV or a laptop. Phones are controllers: answers and bonuses.

home.bigScreenHint: This device shows the picture to everyone, and everyone plays from their phone. The first person to join picks the settings.
home.bigScreenOpen: Use this device as the screen

join.firstIn: You open the game: you will pick the settings

lobby.screenOpen: Open this address on the TV or the laptop:

bonus.shieldUp: Shield up: it will stop the next attack.
bonus.noTarget: Nobody to aim at right now.

error.BAD_PHASE: This bonus would be of no use right now. You keep it.
